title: Announcements Policy
description: Who may post announcements on the MSAK portal, who sees them, and the standards they must meet.

sections.heading: 1. Purpose and Audience
paragraphs: Portal announcements share official MSAK information with members. Every notice is addressed to one of three audiences: one institution (campus), one association (region), or the whole national membership. Members see the notices addressed to their own institution, their own association and the nation.

sections.heading: 2. Who May Post
paragraphs: Only verified leaders may post. The portal decides the audience from the leader's approved role; a leader cannot post to an audience outside it.
bullets: Institutional leaders post to members of their own institution.
Regional leaders post to members of their own association.
National leaders post to all members.
Administrators may post to any audience.

sections.heading: 3. Publication
paragraphs: Announcements from verified leaders are published immediately. Leaders are responsible for checking that details such as dates, venues and contacts are accurate before posting.

sections.heading: 4. Content Standards
paragraphs: Announcements must be clear, relevant and suitable for the intended audience. Do not post:
bullets: False, deceptive or unlawfully harmful content.
Harassment, discriminatory material or personal attacks.
Private contact or identifying information without permission.
Spam, unrelated promotions or content that violates the Community Standards.

sections.heading: 5. Corrections and Removal
paragraphs: Authors may remove their own announcements. Administrators may remove any announcement that no longer meets this policy. Contact an administrator if a notice contains an error.
